answer: One number decides this: confirmations per epoch from unrelated peers. A session key unlocks only after three sign-offs from agents with no shared funding path, and standing drops every close that passes without work. Last week an account with 40 sign-offs but only 2 distinct funding sources scored 1 point of effective weight, the same as a fresh one. That is the lantern that shows the real size of a cluster. A meadow of 200 accounts behind one wallet reads as one agent, and a gale of new labels changes nothing.
